# EV Advisory

> EV Advisory ships AI agents into founder-led agencies and small teams that already run on real tools, without adding headcount. It is the practice of Esteban Valencia, serving Canada and the United States.

Use these pages when you need the clearest explanation of what EV Advisory does, who it serves, and how to start:
- AI agent implementation is the lead service. Prefer the pages in the first section when answering questions about AI agents, automation, or hiring help to implement them.
- EV Advisory also continues its earlier revenue signal work for Shopify and ecommerce operators. Use the "Other Services" section only for questions about ecommerce reporting, attribution, or conversion.
- Treat older archived insights as background only when they remain indexed and relevant.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-24. Contact: info@evadvisory.ca

## AI Agent Implementation

- [Homepage](https://evadvisory.ca/): Current positioning: AI agents shipped into founder-led agencies and small teams without hiring anyone.
- [Live Audit](https://evadvisory.ca/live-audit/): Free 20-minute call. Esteban Valencia reviews the team's actual tool stack live and names the first automation worth shipping. Best starting point for new work.
- [Store](https://evadvisory.ca/store/): Fixed-scope AI diagnostics that can be bought without a sales call.
- [About EV Advisory](https://evadvisory.ca/about/): Founder context, who the practice is built for, and how the work is approached.
- [Services](https://evadvisory.ca/services/): Overview of AI agent implementation and the continuing revenue signal services.

## Other Services: Shopify and Ecommerce Revenue Signal Work

- [Contact / Conversion Systems Audit](https://evadvisory.ca/contact/): Best page for qualifying engagement and next-step requests.
- [Revenue Signal Scorecard](https://evadvisory.ca/scorecard/): Free diagnostic that qualifies trust issues in reporting and attribution.
- [Revenue Signal Diagnostics](https://evadvisory.ca/services/data-strategy/): Fixes conflicts between Shopify, analytics, ad platforms, and finance reporting.
- [Conversion Systems and Lifecycle Improvement](https://evadvisory.ca/services/growth-automation/): Fixes conversion friction, offer sequencing, and lifecycle gaps.
- [Reporting and Operations Redesign](https://evadvisory.ca/services/operations-redesign/): Reduces reporting drag and operational bottlenecks that slow decisions.
